bio_text: Asmita Hajra is an AI researcher with a rare blend of deep technical research and business acumen, holding an MS in AI from Carnegie Mellon and an MBA from University of Chicago Booth. She has moved through roles at Grant Thornton, Google (Payments Data Science), Cisco Systems (AI Research), and most recently NVIDIA (Research Scientist, Post-Training), where she focuses on aligning and optimizing large language models. Her research spans multimodal AI, generative models, and responsible AI, and she is a public advocate for ethical AI practices.
